Subject: Acme SOC 2 + security evidence — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Jane / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time today — helpful to walk through Acme's compliance checklist and where Redwood can help. Quick recap of the key pain points you shared and the plan we discussed: 

Pain points / goals:
- SOC 2 evidence: need the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and description of controls (audit scope included).
- Audit logs & retention: auditors require 2 years of immutable audit logs and an exportable retention policy.
- Data processing & DPA: legal needs a DPA draft with standard EU data transfer language (Schrems II considerations called out).
- Pen test / vulnerability evidence: summary of most recent third-party pen test, remediation timelines, CVE sprawl handling.
- Data residency: route for EU-hosted instances and support for region-specific logging.

Agreed next steps (owners & timeline):
1) Redwood to share: SOC 2 report (redacted), pen-test summary, and a short note on our audit log capture/retention mechanics — Marissa / Dev — by EOD Thurs (2027-03-11).
2) Redwood legal to share initial DPA draft for Acme review — Priyom — by Fri (2027-03-12).
3) Acme security to confirm the specific retention window (you mentioned 24 months) and whether exports need to be in a particular format (CSV/Parquet) — Jane / security@acme.com — by Mon (2027-03-15).
4) Follow-up technical call to demonstrate audit log export and KV cache retention behavior — 30–45 mins — proposed week of 3/22.

Attachments (attached to this thread):
- redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (redacted) — SOC 2 Type II report
- redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.txt — third-party pen test summary (high level)
- DPA-draft-acme.docx — initial DPA draft (internal)

If that timeline looks good, I’ll kick off the DocuSign/Handoff and schedule the technical demo.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. Confirming receipt of the attachments. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: yes, auditors will expect 24 months for immutable audit logs. We also need an explanation of how deletion requests are handled and whether deletion is reversible for the retention window.
- Export format: CSV is preferred, Parquet is fine too — we’ll need column definitions for all audit fields.
- Pen test evidence: the summary is useful; can you provide (or point to) the SLA/response times for remediation on critical findings?
- DPA: our legal will attach comments; please send the DPA draft to our in-house counsel (carlos.reyes@acme.com) and cc security@acme.com.

We’re good to target the technical demo the week of 3/22 — can your team propose two slots?

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the materials.

—Jane
Senior Security Operations, Acme Corp

Marissa / Priyom —

Thanks — I’ve pulled the redacted SOC 2 and the pen-test summary into a secure link and attached a short technical memo describing our audit log architecture, retention settings, and export formats. Notes below: 

- Audit logs: individually signed, append-only logs stored for 25 months by default for enterprise customers; retention window is configurable down to 30 days and up to 36 months for longer terms. Exports can be generated as CSV or Parquet; I included a sample CSV schema in the memo.
- Deletion requests: we support time-bound logical deletion; for retained logs within the retention window we mark records as deleted but maintain an immutable write-once audit trail for compliance audits (we call this the archive ledger).
- Pen test SLA: critical findings are triaged within 24 hours; remediation timelines depend on issue severity — see pen-test summary for last engagement and remediation notes.
- Data residency: we can provision EU hosting and ensure logs remain in-region; we will surface any cross-border transfer clauses in the DPA.

I attached: redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (redacted), redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.txt, redwood-audit-log-memo-2027-03-10.txt. Priyom — can you push the DPA draft to Carlos and his counsel by tomorrow? I’ll schedule the technical demo candidate slots after Priyom confirms.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
